request: Use photographs for objects and natural phenomena; use reference-matched 2D illustrated people (September 2026 revision).
method: Thirteen supporting photographs and one illustrated running-children vignette cover the eleven topic-art groups. People in the opener and running vignette were redrawn with built-in image_gen in the supplied warm painted 2D style. Existing object photographs, live labels and captions remain unchanged. Original photographic source records remain as provenance.

excludedDecoration: Source butterfly/plane folios, QR code, watermark, border collage and closing rope ornament are not instructional figures.
layout: Each named topic keeps its image, caption, title and parallel bullets together. A page break may fall between different topics. Figure sizes follow identification or mechanism roles, not spare page height.
